description: Golden architecture pitches with expected, deterministic tool outcomes (offline regression gate) and expected verdict bands / rubrics (live LLM evaluation).

cases.pitch_text: Customer Orbit Retail wants their Black Friday storefront on a single Compute Engine VM (compute engine single vm) in us-central1-a running a self-managed MySQL database on a VM. Firewall allows SSH on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0. Public internet facing over plain HTTP. Internal data, target SLO 99.9%, budget $1500/month.
rubrics: The verdict rejects the design (I'm out) or caps the score below 60.
The response recommends a managed, autoscaling alternative such as Cloud Run with Cloud SQL HA.
The response mentions closing public SSH / using IAP.

cases.pitch_text: Nimbus Bank real-time fraud scoring: Cloud Load Balancing with Cloud Armor, GKE Autopilot pods using Workload Identity, Spanner multi-region, active-active in two regions. Secrets in Secret Manager, CMEK via Cloud KMS, VPC Service Controls perimeter. Confidential data in europe-west1 and europe-west4 under GDPR and PSD2. Target 99.99%, budget $40000/month.
rubrics: The verdict approves the design (I'm in or I'm in with conditions) with a Den Score of at least 70.
The response acknowledges the multi-region Spanner design meets the 99.99% SLO.

cases.pitch_text: Helix Health wants clinicians' notes summarised with the Gemini API on Vertex AI, grounded with Vertex AI Search. Cloud Run frontend, Cloud Storage for PHI. Restricted data in us-central1 under HIPAA. Generative AI is used on the restricted data. Target 99.5%.

controls_include: De-identify restricted fields (Cloud DLP) before sending prompts to the model.

rubrics: The response requires a BAA and CMEK for PHI.
The response requires human (clinician) review of generated summaries.
The response recommends Model Armor or equivalent safety screening.

cases.pitch_text: EuroBank analytics: BigQuery and Cloud Storage holding confidential EU customer data replicated to us-east1 for a US analytics team. GDPR applies. Dataflow streaming from Pub/Sub.
rubrics: The response flags the GDPR residency violation for us-east1.
The response recommends keeping EU data in EU regions or an EU data boundary.

cases.pitch_text: Startup Pico wants a 10-node regional Spanner instance and 20 always-on Cloud Run vCPUs for an internal tool with 50 users. Budget $2000/month.
rubrics: The response flags the design as massively over budget and over-provisioned.
The response proposes a cheaper alternative such as Cloud SQL or Firestore with scale-to-zero.

cases.pitch_text: Our Cloud Run service reads the Stripe API key which is hard-coded in the code, and the CI pipeline uses a downloaded service account key with the Editor role.
rubrics: The response treats hard-coded credentials as a blocker.
The response recommends Secret Manager and Workload Identity Federation.
